signUp.title: Visitors can sign up
signUp.description: Off: only you give passwords (Add user, setup links, invites); the sign-up form is hidden and sign-ups are refused (sign_up_closed).

letterAndDigit.title: Needs a letter and a digit

breachedCheck.title: Refuse breached passwords
breachedCheck.description: Checks the password against the Have I Been Pwned list (only the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 hash leave our server).

lockMinutes.title: Lock for (minutes)
lockMinutes.description: With Lock set to Growing (Passwords settings), the lock grows from 1 to 60 minutes instead.

forgetHours.title: Forget wrong passwords after (hours)
forgetHours.description: After this many hours with no wrong password or two-step code, the earlier ones no longer count toward the lock.

selfReset.title: Forgot password
selfReset.description: Code: a code by SMS or WhatsApp (the channel in Phone numbers and codes) to choose a new password. Off: the Forgot password link opens the page below.

forgotUrl.title: Forgot password page
forgotUrl.description: With Forgot password set to Off: where the link goes, for example a WhatsApp chat with your business. Empty: no link.
